question: The difference between an interior angle and exterior angle of a regular polygon is 120°. Find the number of sides of the polygon.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In any **regular polygon**, the sum of an **interior angle (I)** and an **exterior angle (E)** is always 180°.

Given: I − E = 120° and we know I + E = 180°.

Subtracting the equations: (I + E) − (I − E) = 180° − 120° ⇒ 2E = 60° ⇒ E = 30°.

**Number of sides (n)** = 360° ÷ Exterior angle = 360° ÷ 30° = 12.

**∴ The correct answer is 12 sides.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Difference between **interior angle** and **exterior angle** = 120°

**Formula Used:**

1. Interior angle (I) + Exterior angle (E) = 180°

2. Number of sides (n) = 360° ÷ Exterior angle (E)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b4616e31677142e41ada23604591d911aaa17e532bd9f4bb41a3c8cd1cee9d0d.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the **interior angle** be I and the **exterior angle** be E.

⇒ I − E = 120° — (Equation 1)

⇒ I + E = 180° — (Equation 2)

⇒ Adding (1) and (2): 2I = 300° ⇒ I = 150°

⇒ Substituting I in (2): 150° + E = 180° ⇒ E = 30°

⇒ Number of sides (n) = 360° ÷ E

⇒ n = 360° ÷ 30°

⇒ n = 12

**∴ The correct answer is 12 sides.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Sum of Interior Angles

The sum of all interior angles of a polygon with n sides is given by (n − 2) × 180°.

Sum of Exterior Angles

The sum of all exterior angles of any convex polygon is always 360°, regardless of the number of sides.

Each Interior Angle of a Regular Polygon

For a regular polygon, each interior angle is [(n − 2) × 180°] ÷ n.</p
